message:
fix(log-upload): a 401 pause with a full queue no longer spins the worker; idle-alive diag on the clock; workerCycles

The worker's wake condition treated "queue >= batchMaxBytes" as a reason to run even while a
401 pause (or missing credentials) forbade every send, so next_job found nothing and the loop
re-entered at once: one core and an "idle alive" diag line every 30 cycles (772 KB/s measured).
The queue now wakes the worker only when it may send; a paused worker sleeps its flush interval
like an idle one, and configure/clear (wakeSeq) and stop still wake it at once. The idle-alive
line is throttled by time (once a minute), not by cycle count. LogUploadStatus.workerCycles is a
test seam. Fencing, retry budget, hold bound and queue cap are unchanged.

Regression [10] with product defaults (192 KiB batch, 2 s flush): before the fix 364,024 cycles,
+1 MB diag and 1,984 ms CPU in 2 s; after it 1 cycle, 0 B, 0 ms; the new token then drains the
held batch first and the queue in batches. Stabilization audit A01 (U3 / probe Q1); history #416.
